process MOBSUITE_CLUSTER {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/7c/7ca9972cb410cbd9e028437e0dd286bb76986565610432ecbb8e38ac63744bc4/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/mob_suite:3.1.9--eaef3d58d6b4b3f2'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(fasta), path(mobtyper_report), path(taxonomy)
    tuple val(meta2), path(ref_cluster, stageAs: 'ref/*'), path(ref_fasta, stageAs: 'ref/*')
    path(taxa_sqlite, stageAs: 'taxa/*')

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/clusters.txt"), emit: clusters
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/references_updated.fasta"), emit: fasta
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.msh"), emit: mash
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.n*"), emit: blastdb
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('mobsuite'), eval("mob_cluster --version | sed 's/mob_cluster //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_mobsuite

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    if (!ref_cluster != !ref_fasta) {
        error("ref_cluster and ref_fasta must be provided together (update mode) or both omitted (build mode)")
    }
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def mode = ref_cluster ? 'update' : 'build'
    def ref_cluster_cmd = ref_cluster ? "--ref_cluster_file ${ref_cluster}" : ''
    def ref_fasta_cmd = ref_fasta ? "--ref_fasta_file ${ref_fasta}" : ''
    def is_compressed = fasta.getName().endsWith(".gz") ? true : false
    def fasta_name = fasta.getName().replace(".gz", "")
    """
    if [ "${is_compressed}" == "true" ]; then
        gzip -c -d ${fasta} > ${fasta_name}
    fi

    mkdir -p db
    ln -s ../${taxa_sqlite} db/taxa.sqlite

    mob_cluster \\
        --mode ${mode} \\
        --infile ${fasta_name} \\
        --mob_typer_file ${mobtyper_report} \\
        --taxonomy ${taxonomy} \\
        ${ref_cluster_cmd} \\
        ${ref_fasta_cmd} \\
        --database_directory db \\
        --num_threads ${task.cpus} \\
        --outdir ${prefix} \\
        ${args}

    [ -s ${prefix}/clusters.txt ] || { echo "mob_cluster failed, see log above" >&2; exit 1; }
    """

    stub:
    if (!ref_cluster != !ref_fasta) {
        error("ref_cluster and ref_fasta must be provided together (update mode) or both omitted (build mode)")
    }
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo ${args}

    mkdir -p ${prefix}
    touch ${prefix}/clusters.txt
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.msh
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.ndb
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.nhr
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.nin
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.njs
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.not
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.nsq
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.ntf
    touch ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.nto
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/mobsuite/cluster"
description: "Build a new plasmid MOB-cluster database, or assign new plasmids to\
  \ the clusters of an existing one\n"
keywords:
- "bacteria"
- "plasmid"
- "cluster"
- "database"
- "genomics"
tools:
- mobsuite:
    description: "MOB-suite is a set of tools for finding, typing and reconstruction\
      \ of plasmids from draft and complete genome assemblies."
    homepage: "https://github.com/phac-nml/mob-suite"
    documentation: "https://github.com/phac-nml/mob-suite/blob/master/README.md"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/phac-nml/mob-suite"
    doi: "10.1099/mgen.0.000206"
    licence:
    - "Apache-2.0"
    identifier: "biotools:mob_suite"
    args_id: "$args"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Plasmid sequences to cluster, optionally gzipped; IDs must match\
        \ the `sample_id` column of the MOB-typer report"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fna}{,.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - mobtyper_report:
      type: "file"
      description: "MOB-typer report (TSV), e.g. from `mob_typer --multi`"
      pattern: "*.{txt,tsv}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  - taxonomy:
      type: "file"
      description: "Taxonomy table (TSV) with header `sample_id<TAB>organism`"
      pattern: "*.{txt,tsv}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference database information\ne.g. `[\
        \ id:'database' ]`\n"
  - ref_cluster:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. Existing MOB-cluster file (`clusters.txt`) to extend.\n\
        Must be provided together with `ref_fasta` (`update` mode); if both are empty\
        \ the module runs in `build` mode. Providing only one raises an error.\n"
      pattern: "*.txt"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  - ref_fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. Sequences of the existing MOB-cluster database (`references_updated.fasta`\
        \ from a previous run).\nMust be provided together with `ref_cluster` (`update`\
        \ mode); if both are empty the module runs in `build` mode. Providing only\
        \ one raises an error.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fna}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
- taxa_sqlite:
    type: "file"
    description: "Required. ETE3 NCBI taxonomy SQLite database (`taxa.sqlite`), any\
      \ filename; the Seqera container does not ship it.\nThe module links it as `taxa.sqlite`\
      \ into a `db/` directory passed to `--database_directory`.\n"
    pattern: "*"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3621"
output:
  clusters:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/clusters.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Plasmid cluster assignments (TSV); in `update` mode it also\
          \ lists the new plasmids"
        pattern: "*/clusters.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  fasta:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta:
        type: "file"
        description: "Reference sequences of the MOB-cluster database.\nIn `update`\
          \ mode, emitted with the sample `meta` (`meta2` is not propagated), and\
          \ mob_cluster 3.1.9 does not append the new input sequences, so it only\
          \ holds the original references ([mob-suite#184](https://github.com/phac-nml/mob-suite/issues/184)).\n"
        pattern: "*/references_updated.fasta"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  mash:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.msh:
        type: "file"
        description: "Mash sketch of the reference sequences.\nIn `update` mode, it\
          \ lacks the new input sequences ([mob-suite#184](https://github.com/phac-nml/mob-suite/issues/184)).\n"
        pattern: "*/references_updated.fasta.msh"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3911"
  blastdb:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/references_updated.fasta.n*:
        type: "file"
        description: "BLAST nucleotide database files (ndb, nhr, nin, njs, not, nsq,\
          \ ntf, nto) of the reference sequences.\nIn `update` mode, they lack the\
          \ new input sequences ([mob-suite#184](https://github.com/phac-nml/mob-suite/issues/184)).\n"
        pattern: "*/references_updated.fasta.n*"
        ontologies: []
  versions_mobsuite:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - mobsuite:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - mob_cluster --version | sed 's/mob_cluster //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - mobsuite:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - mob_cluster --version | sed 's/mob_cluster //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
